c17_questions.topic: JO supervision is distinct from appeal and decision annulment

citations_for_human_check.pinpoint_hint: JO may criticise but does not change/annul decisions; complaint public-record and timeliness cautions.
Administrative remedies and appeal require the applicable specific legal route.

exception_questions: Do not assert JO can annul consular decisions; check competent appeal body, appeal clock, public record and data minimisation.
c17_questions.question: Please clarify the factual and procedural basis for the matter described as: JO supervision is distinct from appeal and decision annulment.

deadline.rule: JO ordinarily declines matters over two years old; exceptions require assessment; not an appeal filing period.

prerequisites_to_verify: Verify that the challenged conduct was an act of an authority/official within JO jurisdiction
Check timing and whether a separate appeal is available
powers_to_verify: JO may investigate and criticise maladministration
limits: JO cannot reverse the underlying decision, issue the visa or award damages
The complaint and attachments normally become public documents subject to secrecy rules
evidence_to_preserve: Chronology, exact official conduct, written communications, file number, relevant decision, minimized copies
remedy_candidates.filing_channel_for_review: JO official complaint instructions; verify current format and confidentiality treatment.
remedy_candidates.intended_outcome_for_review: Seek independent supervisory scrutiny of alleged maladministration, not an individual visa remedy.
outstanding_checks: Verify jurisdiction and present official source text
Verify factual predicates and contrary evidence
Verify current authority competence, prerequisites and deadlines
